sources.title: Mechanistic Origin of Moral Indifference in Language Models
sources.snippet: To address the aforementioned ontological misalignment, we argue that achieving endogenously aligned AI requires that moral concepts share a similar mechanistic origin. This necessitates exploring novel model architectures and training mechanisms that foster the proactive cultivation of morality, rather than relying on post-hoc corrections.
